reason: In VerifyMessageProperties.java:124-126 (patch line 166-168), for keys starting with linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit and for error-invalid-multivalued-size, normalizeValue runs value.replaceAll("\\{[0-9]+,choice,[^}]*}", "..."), which removes the whole choice body before policy.sanitize.
